universities.name: Technical University of Munich

programmes_english.name: Aerospace B.Sc. (mainly English; some electives in German; German A2 certificate required)
Information Engineering B.Sc., TUM Campus Heilbronn (English; some elective modules in German; German A2 required)
Management and Technology B.Sc., Computer Engineering specialisation (management degree; only specialisation described as 100% English)
Management and Data Science B.Sc., TUM Campus Heilbronn (100% English; management/data degree)

universities.teaching_language_bachelor: Mostly German (for example Informatics B.Sc. is listed as German); a few programmes are taught fully or mainly in English.
universities.eligibility_cbse: DAAD India: Class 12 alone generally does not give direct entry. Usual route is Studienkolleg (preparatory course, German needed) plus the Feststellungspruefung. A valid JEE Advanced rank allows direct application for a subject-specific course. APS India also describes a subject-restricted route after one successful bachelor year, with a 70% Class XII minimum from winter semester 2026/27. Indian bachelor applicants to TUM need a uni-assist VPD (school certificate, transcript, university entrance exam results, APS certificate) as well as the TUMonline application. Admission then uses an aptitude assessment (grades in maths, English and science; possible interview).

tests.jee: JEE Advanced rank is relevant: DAAD India says it permits direct subject-specific application. APS India's JEE leaflet lists proof of JEE Main and Advanced (2023 version).
tests.other_exam: Feststellungspruefung after Studienkolleg if direct entry is not available.
tests.interview: Information Engineering: mandatory interview of about 20 minutes if invited (points system). Aerospace: two-stage assessment with possible interview.
tests.local_language_requirement: German A2 certificate by the application deadline for Aerospace and Information Engineering; German-taught programmes need higher German. English for Aerospace: school certificate, interview or B2 certificate; Information Engineering needs no separate English certificate.

universities.other_requirements: APS certificate from APS India; uni-assist Preliminary Documentation (VPD), usually 4 to 6 weeks processing; certified documents in German or English.

application.opens: 15 May (annual window; Aerospace and Information Engineering first-semester entry is winter only)
application.deadlines_text: Winter semester: 15 May to 15 July. uni-assist VPD for winter semester bachelor applications is due by 15 July; apply early. The pages state the annual window, not a 2027-specific date.

universities.other_fees: Student union semester fee in addition (EUR 97 shown on the Aerospace and Information Engineering pages; varies by campus). Before 2027/28 the usual bachelor rates are EUR 2,000 or 3,000 per semester; the Aerospace page currently shows EUR 3,000. Which 2027/28 band each programme falls in was not verified.

living_cost.amount_text: About EUR 1,300 to 2,000 per month for a single person in the Munich area (TUM pages; seen in search excerpt). Heilbronn costs not verified.

scholarships.name: TUM scholarship for international students
scholarships.value_text: One-time grant of EUR 500 to 1,800 per semester; reapply each semester
scholarships.who: International students, assessed on academic performance and financial circumstances; whether first-semester bachelor entrants qualify was not verified

scholarships.name: Tuition waiver scholarships
scholarships.value_text: Credited against tuition; amount not stated
scholarships.who: Fee-paying students with outstanding performance or financial need

hostel.text: Not guaranteed. TUM has no dormitories of its own; Studierendenwerk Muenchen Oberbayern runs subsidised halls and TUM pages report waits of one to four semesters. Dorm rent cited as about EUR 400 to 600 (another TUM page EUR 350 to 450); shared flat room about EUR 500 to 800. Seen in search excerpts of TUM pages, some written for exchange students.

highlights: Offers a small set of English-taught or mainly English bachelor programmes, including Aerospace and Information Engineering.
JEE Advanced can open a direct route according to DAAD India.
challenges: Class 12 alone generally does not give direct entry: Studienkolleg, JEE Advanced or a completed university year is needed.
German is needed even for English programmes (A2), and most bachelor programmes are in German.
Munich housing is scarce and costly, and non-EU tuition rises from winter semester 2027/28.
universities.notes: Not verified (null): coordinates, climate, application fee, IELTS/TOEFL minimums, SAT, placement statistic, alumni. The English programme list may be incomplete: only the first page of the TUM programme finder was read. QS: main table and profile show 25; a QS top-100 article shows 26. APS 70% / one-year rule and some TUM figures come from search excerpts. How APS applies to CBSE schools in the Gulf was not verified.

universities.name: RWTH Aachen University
universities.teaching_language_bachelor: German. RWTH states bachelor programmes are taught only in German; there is no English-taught bachelor.
universities.eligibility_cbse: A recognised higher education entrance qualification with an overall average at least equivalent to German grade 2.5 (a TestAS result can compensate for a weaker grade), plus German C1 at enrolment. If the school certificate does not qualify, study at home or a Studienkolleg is required. DAAD India: Class 12 alone generally does not give direct entry (route: Studienkolleg and Feststellungspruefung, or a JEE Advanced rank for subject-specific direct application).

tests.jee: Not mentioned on the RWTH pages checked. DAAD India says a JEE Advanced rank permits direct subject-specific application to a German university.
tests.other_exam: TestAS to compensate for an average weaker than 2.5; Feststellungspruefung after Studienkolleg.
tests.local_language_requirement: German C1 at enrolment (for example DSH-2, TestDaF 4 in all sections, Goethe C1, telc C1 Hochschule; check programme regulations). Some programmes such as Computer Science also require English B2.

universities.other_requirements: APS India verification for Indian school certificates (DAAD India). Check recognition on anabin. Certified translations where documents are not in German.

application.opens: 4 May (date published for winter semester 2026/27; 2027 not verified)
application.closes: 15 July for restricted-admission programmes (2026 cycle; 2027 not verified)
application.deadlines_text: Restricted-admission (NC) bachelor programmes: 15 July for winter semester 2026/27. Open-admission programmes: a RWTH table shows a later cut-off of 20 October, which may be out of date. 2027 dates not verified.

universities.other_fees: Compulsory semester contribution (includes Germany-wide semester transit ticket). RWTH pages give conflicting figures: EUR 338.05, EUR 298.06 and EUR 358.34; confirm the current amount.

living_cost.amount_text: Budget at least EUR 1,100 per month.

hostel.text: Not verified: no official page on hall availability, guarantee or rent was retrieved.

highlights: RWTH states there are currently no tuition fees.
The semester contribution includes a Germany-wide semester ticket.
challenges: All bachelor teaching is in German and C1 is required at enrolment.
Class 12 alone generally does not give direct entry, and a 2.5 German-equivalent average (or TestAS) applies.
In restricted programmes, applicants from outside the EU/EEA compete within a 7% quota.
universities.notes: Not verified (null/empty): QS rank (QS profile page refused access), coordinates, climate, application fee, 2027 dates, accommodation, scholarships (not found in the pages searched, which does not mean none exist), placement, alumni. Whether uni-assist is used by RWTH was not verified.

universities.name: Delft University of Technology

programmes_english.name: Aerospace Engineering (offered in English or Dutch; numerus fixus)
Computer Science and Engineering (English track; numerus fixus)
Earth, Climate and Technology (listed as English)

universities.teaching_language_bachelor: Mostly Dutch (including Mechanical, Electrical and Civil Engineering); a few programmes are offered in English.
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE Class XII (academic stream): at least five exam subjects, each at least B1. CISCE ISC: each subject at least 75%. Mathematics must be a final exam subject; further science subjects depend on the programme (Aerospace: Mathematics and Physics; Computer Science: Mathematics). Certificates from other Indian boards do not qualify. English requirement applies in addition.

tests.jee: Not mentioned on the pages checked.
tests.other_exam: Numerus fixus selection (Computer Science: Mathematics and systematic/logical reasoning).
tests.ielts_min: Conflicting: 6.5 overall (CSE teaching and examination regulations 2025-26) versus 7.0 with 6.5 per section (a university-wide regulation). Confirm on the programme page.
tests.toefl_min: Conflicting: 90 versus 100 with 22 per section (same two documents, pre-2026 TOEFL scale).
tests.local_language_requirement: No Dutch requirement identified for the English-taught tracks (not explicitly confirmed).

universities.other_requirements: Certificates for English tests no older than two years.

application.closes: 15 January 2027 for numerus fixus programmes (Aerospace, Computer Science); 1 April for others
application.deadlines_text: Numerus fixus: register before 15 January 2027. Other bachelor programmes: 1 April. CSE intake 2027-28: 590 places, of which 345 on the English track.
application.application_fee: EUR 100 for applicants with an international diploma (2026-27 regulations)

universities.other_fees: Housing service fee EUR 285 (2026/27). Non-EU bachelor students pay a living-cost amount in advance for the residence permit, refunded after arrival less permit and housing fees.

living_cost.amount_text: EUR 14,200 per year for non-EU BSc students in 2026/27 (immigration service requirement); no 2027/28 figure yet.

hostel.text: Not guaranteed. The TU Delft Housing Service can offer rooms to less than 45% of new international students, first paid first served; bachelor contracts are for one year only. Rent about EUR 500 to 1,350 per room per month (seen in search excerpt).

highlights: CBSE and ISC certificates are accepted for direct bachelor entry if grade rules are met.
Computer Science reserves 345 of 590 places in 2027-28 for the English track.
challenges: Aerospace and Computer Science are numerus fixus with an early 15 January deadline and selection.
Every CBSE subject must be B1 or better (ISC 75% in each).
Housing is scarce and non-EU tuition is EUR 20,563 a year.
universities.notes: Not verified (null/empty): coordinates, climate, application opening date, bachelor scholarships for non-EU students (none found on pages checked), placement, alumni. Studielink portal URL is the national portal and was not opened. CSE programme URL is the parent of the verified admission pages. QS: profile shows 48, a QS top-100 article shows 49. Aerospace 2027-28 intake number not verified.

universities.name: Eindhoven University of Technology

programmes_english.name: Chemical Engineering and Chemistry (English version has intake limit from 2027/28)

universities.teaching_language_bachelor: Mainly English according to the 2025-26 student statute; Biomedical Engineering and Medical Sciences and Technology are partly Dutch. Some programmes have separate English and partly Dutch versions.
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE Class XII (academic stream): Mathematics as a final exam subject, Physics and/or Chemistry as the programme requires, at least five relevant subjects, all A1, A2 or B1 (general studies, physical education and work experience do not count). ISC: at least 75% overall, 70% in mandatory subjects, Mathematics, five relevant subjects. Plus English proficiency.

tests.jee: Not mentioned on the pages checked.
tests.other_exam: CSE selection 2027: online selection day 6 March 2027 (logical reasoning 40%, algorithmic thinking 40%, mathematics test 10%, grade average 10%, plus a questionnaire).
tests.ielts_min: 6.5 overall, 6.0 per section (Academic; online test not accepted)
tests.toefl_min: 4.5 overall and per section on the scale from 21 January 2026 (earlier tests: 90 with 21 per section)
tests.local_language_requirement: None for English-taught programmes; Dutch needed for Biomedical Engineering and Medical Sciences and Technology.

universities.other_requirements: Language results no older than two years; residence permit form and payments by 1 June for non-EEA students; guarantee fee.

application.deadlines_text: Numerus fixus: complete application and fee by 15 January 2027; CSE ranking numbers 15 April 2027; maximum two numerus fixus programmes per year. Others: 1 May. Non-EEA visa form and payments by 1 June.

universities.other_fees: Guarantee fee for non-EEA bachelor students EUR 22,700 for 2027-2028, paid in advance (covers residence permit costs and first-year tuition; not an extra tuition charge).

living_cost.amount_text: TU/e currently estimates the required living amount at EUR 14,400 per year (2026 requirement was EUR 13,600; official 2027 figure not yet set).

hostel.text: Not guaranteed. TU/e does not own dormitories; a limited number of rooms is reserved through partners for exchange and non-EU/EEA students. The housing toolkit suggests about EUR 300 to 500 per month, but that figure was unclear in the source and should be rechecked.

highlights: Broad range of engineering and computing bachelors taught in English.
CBSE and ISC certificates are accepted for direct entry if grade rules are met.
challenges: Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture and (from 2027/28, English version) Chemical Engineering have intake limits.
TU/e announced in July 2026 plans for a substantial non-EEA tuition increase and an end to international recruitment for bachelor programmes.
No housing guarantee and an advance guarantee fee of EUR 22,700.
universities.notes: Not verified (null/empty): QS rank (QS profile page refused access), coordinates, climate, bachelor scholarships, placement, alumni. Teaching language of individual programmes rests on the 2025-26 student statute, not on each programme page; several programme URLs point to the common admission list. A lower fee of EUR 19,200 applies only to students who started in 2024-25 or earlier. The announced recruitment and fee plans should be confirmed with TU/e before applying.

universities.name: ETH Zurich
universities.teaching_language_bachelor: German (C1 certificate required for admission); no fully English-taught bachelor was identified.
universities.eligibility_cbse: CBSE (All India Senior School Certificate) or ISC alone leads to the Comprehensive Entrance Examination. With the certificate plus an admission certificate in the desired subject from a recognised Indian university, the Reduced Entrance Examination applies (ETH admission requirements 2026/27). The exam is in German. For an autumn 2027 start, ETH states this is possible only if the certificate qualifies without an exam; the next exam (17 to 27 January 2028) leads to a September 2028 start.

tests.jee: Not mentioned in the India entry of ETH's admission requirements.
tests.other_exam: ETH Entrance Examination: Reduced CHF 550, Comprehensive CHF 800; registration 15 September to 15 October; exam 17 to 27 January 2028.
tests.local_language_requirement: German C1 certificate by 31 March, not older than two years at the start of the application period; ETH offers no German courses before studies.

universities.other_requirements: Admission requirements for autumn semester 2028 are announced separately on ETH's website and should be checked.

application.deadlines_text: Annual window 1 December to 31 March (2027 for the current cycle). Entrance exam registration for the January 2027 session closed on 15 October 2026.

tuition_non_eu.academic_year: rate applying from autumn semester 2025 (current page; 2027/28 not separately published)

universities.other_fees: Compulsory semester charges apply in addition (the international student handbook lists CHF 69 compulsory per semester; may be out of date). Application fee payable, amount not verified. Entrance exam CHF 550 or 800.

living_cost.amount_text: ETH approximate sheet for international students: total study and living costs about CHF 25,200 to 28,100 per year (undated; seen in search excerpt).

hostel.text: Not guaranteed; students mostly find rooms on the local market or through student housing such as WOKO. ETH handbook estimate CHF 500 to 900 per month for a single room with shared kitchen and bathroom (may be out of date).

highlights: Defined route for Indian certificate holders through ETH's entrance examination.
Tuition for most foreign students is CHF 2,190 per semester.
challenges: Entry for Indian school-certificate holders requires an entrance exam in German; a 2027 start is closed to those who need it and did not register by 15 October 2026.
German C1 is required by 31 March.
High living costs and no housing guarantee.
universities.notes: Not verified (null/empty): coordinates, climate, application fee amount, bachelor scholarships for non-EU students (none verified), placement, alumni. An April 2025 ETH statement discussed possible further large fee rises linked to 2027 federal budget cuts; the outcome was not verified.

universities.name: EPFL (Ecole polytechnique federale de Lausanne)
universities.teaching_language_bachelor: French (B2 required, C1 recommended); no fully English-taught bachelor was identified.
universities.eligibility_cbse: For certificates from outside the EU, EFTA and UK there is no direct first-year entry: options are the CMS preparatory year (only for countries listed in EPFL's CMS conditions, with at least 12 years of schooling, six of seven set subjects including Mathematics and Physics, and 80% in the general average, Mathematics and Physics; limited places) or the EPFL entrance examination (no grade condition). Whether India is on the CMS country list was not verified.

tests.jee: Not mentioned on the pages checked.
tests.other_exam: Entrance exam: scientific subjects 18 to 22 January 2027, general subjects August to September 2027; registration 1 October to 1 December 2026; documents in French; CHF 150 registration plus CHF 550 (reduced) or CHF 800 (full).
tests.local_language_requirement: French B2 required (C1 recommended); applicants who did not study French in upper secondary school must prove the level when applying.

universities.other_requirements: First-year bachelor places capped at 3,000 for at least four years from 2025; the limit affects foreign certificate holders. Passing the CMS or entrance exam guarantees admission.

application.deadlines_text: Online registration and fee by 30 April for a September start; documents by 10 July (30 September for certificates issued after 10 July); proof of completed qualification by 30 September. Entrance exam registration closes 1 December 2026.
application.application_fee: CHF 150 for holders of a foreign certificate

tuition_non_eu.academic_year: tripled rate from autumn 2025; 2027/28 amount not separately confirmed

universities.other_fees: Additional semester fees apply (EPFL fee page invoice totals are inconsistent; confirm). A bachelor FAQ still shows an older figure of CHF 1,460 per year.

living_cost.amount_text: Foreign students: CHF 2,107 per month (CHF 25,219 per year); EPFL advises about CHF 29,000 per year for living expenses, plus tuition.

hostel.text: Not guaranteed: EPFL's housing office says applying does not ensure a room and advises applying to several residences. EPFL budgets housing at CHF 900 per month.

highlights: Passing the entrance exam or CMS guarantees admission despite the first-year cap.
Entrance exam is open to holders of non-EU/EFTA/UK school certificates.
challenges: Teaching and entrance exam are in French (B2 minimum).
No direct entry on an Indian school certificate: CMS or entrance exam is needed.
High living costs, capped places and no housing guarantee.
universities.notes: Not verified (null/empty): coordinates, climate, CMS eligibility for India, bachelor scholarships (page mentions restrictive criteria; none verified), placement, alumni. Tuition rests on a search excerpt of an older EPFL fee page. Whether both exam blocks must be passed for a September 2027 start should be checked in the exam regulation (French).
